name: Silo
description: Silo is a self-hosted media server for films, series, audiobooks, ebooks, podcasts and manga. It direct-plays, remuxes or transcodes with VA-API, Quick Sync and NVENC, and exposes Jellyfin/Emby- and Audiobookshelf-compatible APIs for existing clients.

notes.text: Silo is pre-release and tracks the main branch. Back up the container before every update.
Back up SECRET_KEY from /opt/silo_data/.env separately: without it, stored credentials cannot be recovered.
Mount your media into the container, then create the admin account on first visit. Jellyfin clients connect on port 8096, Audiobookshelf clients on 13378.
